item.title: The best-dressed celebrities at the 2026 Grammy Awards
item.description: The stars weren't afraid to have fun with their 2026 Grammys fashion, with Sabrina Carpenter stepping out in one of the best looks of the night.

item.title: 12 celebrity outfits that missed the mark at the 2026 Grammys
item.description: While many stars walked the 2026 Grammys red carpet in eye-catching looks, others, like Heidi Klum and Shaboozey, missed the mark with their outfits.

item.title: 'A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' just revealed Egg's true identity. And yes, that prophecy comes true in the books.
item.description: "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" episode three reveals Egg's true identity and Targaryen connection. Here's what happens to him in the books.

item.title: From Bad Bunny to Billie Eilish, celebrities sounded off on ICE at the 2026 Grammys
item.description: Grammy Award winners like Bad Bunny, Olivia Dean, and Billie Eilish made comments about immigration and spoke out against ICE onstage.

item.title: The 5 best performances at the 2026 Grammys — and 3 that fell flat
item.description: The 68th Grammy Awards took place on Sunday. Artists like Sabrina Carpenter and Lady Gaga delivered standout performances, while others fell flat.

item.title: Kylie Kelce says there's one habit she insists on modeling in front of her 4 daughters
item.description: Kylie Kelce, who has four daughters, says she leads "by example" when it comes to practicing self-love at home.

item.title: Photos show the history of the Kennedy Center, which Trump is shutting down for 2 years
item.description: The Trump Kennedy Center will be closed for two years from July. Here's a look back at how it came to be and how it has changed under Trump.

item.title: I embedded myself in a vibe coding team at Gemini's AI hackathon in Singapore. Building an app in 7 hours takes real work.
item.description: I followed a hackathon team as they raced to vibe code an app in seven hours at Google's Gemini 3 Hackathon in Singapore.

item.title: A $26 billion software company is selling a US unit that has a contract with ICE
item.description: Capgemini has come under pressure from French lawmakers and its trade union over a contract its subsidiary signed with ICE.

item.title: The creator of Clawdbot, the viral AI agent, says he got so obsessed with vibe coding it pulled him into a 'rabbit hole'
item.description: The creator of Clawdbot, the viral AI agent, says vibe coding can blur into compulsion, creating the illusion of productivity without real progress.
